item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meera's school in Pune has a garden pond with pondweed, small fish that eat the pondweed, and dragonfly larvae that eat the small fish. Kingfishers visit the pond to catch the fish.

One year, most of the pondweed dies after polluted water enters the pond.

What is the most likely effect on the dragonfly larvae in the pond?

options.A: Their population will increase, because the pondweed will no longer compete with them for oxygen.
options.B: Their population will decrease, because the small fish they eat will have less food and fewer fish will survive.
options.C: Their population will stay the same, because the loss of pondweed affects only the pondweed itself.
options.D: Their population will stay the same, because they can breathe oxygen directly from the air above the pond.
